tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. The warm greige ground every other surface sits on.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, tracks and unselected chips on `surface-page`. Reads one step darker than the ground.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Default card and panel fill on `surface-page`. A touch lighter than the ground in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: White pills, inputs, selected chips and floating cards. Pair with `shadow-soft`.

tokens.name: surface-slate
tokens.usage: Mid-tone chips and headers (the dark-gray pills in the reference). Text on it is `on-slate`.

tokens.name: surface-ink
tokens.usage: Always-dark panels: navigation rails, inverted cards, the cover slab. Text on it is `on-ink` or `on-ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface-page`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-card` and `surface-raised` in each theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, placeholders and units on `surface-page`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-card` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface-slate`.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface-ink`.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-ink`.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on every bright fill: `volt`, `lime`, `ember`, `amber`, `periwinkle` and the `tint-*` colors. Never white on these.

tokens.name: on-fill-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the four `tint-*` fills.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (the black pill in light, the volt pill in dark). Text on it is `on-action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action`.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Brand accent: active markers, highlights, key data, the one thing to look at. Fill only, with `on-fill` text. Never as text on a light surface.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Positive status and completed states. Fill only, with `on-fill` text.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Warm signal: primary calls on warm layouts, alerts that need attention. Fill only, with `on-fill` text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning and secondary warm surfaces. Fill only, with `on-fill` text.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Informational fill and chart secondary series. Fill only, with `on-fill` text.

tokens.name: tint-rose
tokens.usage: Pastel category tile fill. Text on it is `on-fill` or `on-fill-muted`.

tokens.name: tint-sand
tokens.usage: Pastel category tile fill. Text on it is `on-fill` or `on-fill-muted`.

tokens.name: tint-lilac
tokens.usage: Pastel category tile fill. Text on it is `on-fill` or `on-fill-muted`.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: Pastel category tile fill. Text on it is `on-fill` or `on-fill-muted`.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Link and small data-label text on `surface-page`, `surface-card` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and borders on `surface-page`, `surface-card` and `surface-raised`. Always pair with a word or the square glyph.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `danger` fill.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outline controls (3:1 or better on every surface). Use `hairline` for decoration only.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid with a 3px offset. On `surface-ink` use `volt`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines on marketing pages. Light weight, one line or two.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Panel titles and the wordmark when no logo is supplied.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Small group headings and table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase eyebrow labels over metrics.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: Hero numbers in a stat tile. Light weight, unit set in `body` beside it.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Dense data tables and log lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a pill, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space above a page-level heading.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small tags and tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner tiles nested inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Category tiles and compact cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Default card and panel. The signature soft corner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Page shells and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, inputs and nav rails. Anything a thumb presses.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and chips.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, chips and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero calls to action.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: White pills and cards resting on the greige ground.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dragged cards.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Pressed controls and sunken tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-halo
tokens.usage: Glow ring around a `volt` marker on a timeline or map node.
